name: sandbox
notes: Public dual-runtime hobby/research repository. T1 permits reversible local work and scoped publishing, but merge remains gated because the repository has no GitHub Actions workflow and performance claims require explicit Release evidence. Claude uses the shared global PreToolUse floor. Codex uses the shared dispatcher through the repository-owned .codex/hooks.json adapter; that adapter is inactive until its exact definition is reviewed and trusted in a fresh Codex session via /hooks. No sensitive or production data is expected. human_todo is null because no human-only operational gate exists.
